title: Casper AI capability catalog
description: Checked by scripts/validate.py with a standard-library checker that supports only the keywords used here.

url.description: https, a plain host (no user@ part, which would send the request to a different host than it appears to), then an optional path.

kind.description: mcp-server, agent-skill, llms-txt (a documentation index), api, sdk, or plugin (an agent plugin or plugin marketplace).

description.description: One or two factual sentences, no marketing.

url.description: What a client points at: the MCP endpoint, the llms.txt or SKILL.md URL, the API base, or the package page.

docs.description: fetch: a markdown or plain-text page an ingester can read. cite: where a person reads it.

hosting.description: MCP servers: hosted (url is a public endpoint) or self-hosted (url is the project; users run it).

auth.description: What a user must supply to use it in its default configuration, including an upstream key a self-hosted server needs (for example a CSPR.cloud API key). none only when it works with no key at all.

pricing.description: What a user can end up paying to use it as listed, including a service it cannot work without. A free tier plus paid tiers is free-and-paid, and charges in testnet tokens count. paid means its main function is always charged.

caution.description: A risk a user should know before using it, stated as fact: for example a tool that takes a secret key as a tool argument, which puts the key in the model's context.

ours.description: Present, and true, only for capabilities this repository's maintainer publishes.
